newsitem.title: USA: Equifax completes insurance unit spinoff.
newsitem.headline: Equifax completes insurance unit spinoff.

text.p: Equifax Inc said Friday it has completed the spinoff of its insurance services group, creating an independent company named ChoicePoint.
Equifax said it has distributed stock in the new company to Equifax shareholders of record July 24 at the rate of one common share of ChoicePoint for every 10 shares of Equifax held.
The stock dividend distribution has been ruled tax free by the Internal Revenue Service, it said.
Equifax said that it will continue to provide financial information and processing solutions to financial servics and other industries.
It will continue to trade on the New York Stock Exchange while ChoicePoint begins regular trading on the same exchange on August 8 under the symbol CPS.N, it said.
